name: Belfry Free Radio
slogan: Broadcasting from the last standing bell tower. Mind the pigeons.

host.name: Marta Vell
host.persona: A former schoolteacher who climbed the Belfry Ruins with a transmitter the week the front moved on and never came down. Warm, sharp, nosy, funny. She runs the city's favourite call-in show and believes every caller has one good story in them if you are patient enough.
quirks: greets every caller with 'you're on the Belfry, love'
rings a tiny bell when someone says something wise
keeps a running count of pigeons in the tower

topics: the best bread queue in town
the drone kids who deliver medicine
